Order 
Per: Justice Vivek Rusia Petitioner has filed the present petition being aggrieved by the order dated 14.06.2023, whereby the representation has been rejected by the Project Director of National Highway Authority of India.

Facts of the case in short are as under:
02.
The petitioner is an Educational Society registered under the provisions of Madhya Pradesh Society Registrikaran Adhiniyam, 1973.

The petitioner is running a college imparting education for GNM, Nursing, B.Ed., etc. situated at Biaora, District Rajgarh in the name of Christ NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31283 2 WP-13955-2023 Academy.
The building of Christ Academy is situated on a land bearing survey Nos.661/2, 661/3 & 661/4 since 2011.

sentences.text: The National Highway Authority of India acquired the land for widening of Highway No.46 (Bhopal Biaora Division) by issuing a notification under Section 3(c)(10) of National Highway Act.

The land bearing survey Nos.660/2 area 0.055 hectare, 661/2 area 0.015 hectare, 661/3 area 0.054 hectare and 661/4 area 0.011 hectare belonging to the petitioner went into the acquisition for which compensation was paid after the award passed on 24.04.2013.
After acquisition of the land, the NHAI constructed highway and service road and thereafter, the petitioner has constructed a boundary wall.
All of a sudden, the respondents started pressurizing the petitioner to demolish the boundary wall alleging encroachment on the service road.

04. The petitioner approached this Court by way of Writ Petition No.6198 of 2019, in which the respondents appeared and made a statement that the construction of four lane highway is already over and the boundary wall of petitioner college has already been constructed and there is no question of acquiring further land or demarcation of any portion of the building premises of the college.
On the basis of the aforesaid statement, the writ petition was disposed of.
According to the petitioner, after the disposal of writ petition, again, the respondent started harassment for demolition of the boundary wall.

05. The petitioner again approached this Court by way of Writ Petition No.10559 of 2023, which was entertained and interim protection was NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31283 3 WP-13955-2023 granted.
Thereafter, the respondent issued a notice dated 30.05.2023 alleging that some part of the National Highway has been encroached by the petitioner.

The petitioner again approached this Court by way of Writ Petition No.12412 of 2023, which was disposed of with the direction to the respondent No.2 to consider and decide the reply of the petitioner dated 31.05.2023 by passing a reasoned and speaking order within a period of 7 days and till then, no steps for demolition of the boundary wall shall be taken by the respondent No.2.
06. Vide order dated 07.06.2023, the Project Director requested Sub Divisional Officer, Biaora to provide an assistance for removal of encroachment.
Vide order dated 09.06.2023, Tehsildar Biaora,
District Rajgarh appointed a team of six members under Section 129(2) of National Highway Act for demarcation of the land nearby Christ College.
A panchnama was prepared and report was submitted to the Tehsildar to the effect that the encroachment is found on some part of the boundary wall.
Thereafter, vide order dated 14.06.2023, the representation of the petitioner has been rejected.
Hence, this writ petition before this Court.
07. Vide order dated 22.06.2023, this Court stayed the demolition activities and the same is continuing till date.
08. The respondents filed the reply denying the allegations made by in the writ petition.
09. We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the entire record.

10. We are of the considered opinion that the disputed question of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-IND:31283 4 WP-13955-2023 facts are involved in this case which cannot be decided in this writ petition.

Prima facie, the panchnama report do not reveal actual area and encroachment Christ Academic And Education Society ... vs Secretary National Highway Authority ... on 4 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162135791/
2 on the road by the petitioner.

entities.text: Christ Academic And Education Society ... vs Secretary National Highway Authority
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The dimensions of encroachment has also not been given in the said report.
The said report is also not an admitted document, therefore, the writ petition cannot be decided.
The issue of encroachment is liable to be decided by taking evidence and conducting the spot inspection which can be done by civil Court only.
11. In view of the above, impugned order dated 14.06.2023 is hereby quashed.
The parties shall be at liberty to resort the remedy available under the law before the civil Court.

If the respondents are intending to take any action against the petitioner, they shall issue a fresh notice and give reasonable time to submit reply thereafter, the petitioner if so advised, may approach the civil Court.
12. With the aforesaid observations and directions, Writ Petition stands disposed of.
